spec: R6 coverage gate, R8 chaining control, R10 walk-forward, R11 cross-fitted headroom, S2 criteria

R6_coverage_gate.on_failure: return UNRESOLVED; thresholds are NOT lowered after inspecting model results

measure: whether stale(episode k+1) appears in reference ensemble k
shared element IDs across adjacent episodes
element overlap across training, validation and deployment windows

R10_walk_forward.sequence: closed history -> training -> validation -> select candidate -> decide gate -> freeze model/scaler/G -> deployment episode -> labels close later -> next refresh
R10_walk_forward.stride_in_days_rationale: expressed in wall-clock days so NOMINAL (24 h) and DEGRADED (72 h) scenarios get the same decision cadence rather than the same episode count
R10_walk_forward.validation_placement: chronologically last 25 percent of closed history immediately preceding the decision point
R10_walk_forward.inference_scope_assertion: the deployment predictor receives no reference element, no reference epoch, no reference publication time, no ensemble and no label; enforced mechanically

R11_cross_fitted_headroom.purpose: replace the previous IN-SAMPLE 9.82 percent figure, which is not evidence of achievable benefit
R11_cross_fitted_headroom.scoring: OUT OF SAMPLE on later episodes
R11_cross_fitted_headroom.naming: cross-fitted headroom diagnostics, NOT oracle bounds
R11_cross_fitted_headroom.not_deployable_candidates: none of these may be deployed unless already present in M1-M7
R11_cross_fitted_headroom.interpretation_rule: if even the cross-fitted quadratic diagnostic fails to approach the 5 percent margin consistently across satellites, record that the studied observable state has little reachable headroom

S2_analysis.statistical_unit: the pass, aggregated to the deployment episode. Within-pass samples are never independent units.
S2_analysis.aggregation: equal weight per satellite; within a satellite the effect is the mean over deployment episodes of (MAE_candidate - MAE_SGP4)
S2_analysis.uncertainty: hierarchical block bootstrap, 10000 resamples: resample satellites, then MOVING BLOCKS of contiguous deployment episodes within each selected satellite
S2_analysis.moving_block_length_rule: max(4, ceil(integrated autocorrelation scale of the episode-RMS residual)), computed per satellite from TRAINING chronology only
S2_analysis.moving_block_rationale: the previous pilot's i.i.d. episode resampling understated intervals by 3-4x for the two satellites with episode-RMS lag-1 ACF above 0.75

satellite_clusters_for_leave_one_out.note: objects sharing a launch or an orbit are not independent draws; clusters declared from orbital period agreement, not from results

S2_pass_criteria_all_eleven_required.5: no satellite contributes more than 50 percent of the aggregate benefit
S2_pass_criteria_all_eleven_required.6: effect sign stable across adjacent walk-forward episodes
S2_pass_criteria_all_eleven_required.7: result not dependent on one screen setting
S2_pass_criteria_all_eleven_required.9: conclusion not reversed at the 20 degree diagnostic threshold
S2_pass_criteria_all_eleven_required.10: harmful-admission rate <= 0.20 with enough admissions to estimate it (>= 10 admitted segments)
S2_pass_criteria_all_eleven_required.11: improvement larger than, or demonstrably robust to, ensemble-reference uncertainty

explicit_non_passes: improvement visible only after deleting many rows

hard_termination.if_FAIL: stop the residual-learning paper line; do not redesign features, change cadence, lower the visibility threshold, change the reference ensemble, build E5/E6, or rewrite the manuscript as a negative or leakage paper
hard_termination.if_UNRESOLVED_on_coverage_or_label_quali: stop this dataset route; report that the available TLE archive cannot support the required causal test; do not keep iterating on the same archive
hard_termination.if_PASS: freeze code/config/artifacts; request human approval before E5; do not edit the manuscript

after_registry_and_labels.A: satellite visibility, timing and availability causality
after_registry_and_labels.B: selection bias, censoring and label uncertainty
